text:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding run for hyperion13b (int4) started hitting OOMs when we push max_new_tokens > 256. Low QPS repro in canary but high variance across instances.

jason: logs? stack traces?

mira: pasted a short excerpt from the agent log: 
```
E OOM: attempted alloc 1.2GiB after prefetched KV; slot compactor unable to free contiguous region
KV-cache: entries 12k, fragmented_slots: 83%
prefetch: enabled, microbatch: 2, max_new_tokens: 512
```

anita: 83% frag is screaming slot fragmentation. Which kernel scheduler are these canaries on?

mira: kernel-sched=v2 (default), GPUs are A100-80G, driver 535.x

riley: try soft-evict heuristic + disable aggressive prefetch for this model. On similar runs we used: 
```yaml
model_defaults:
  prefetch: false
  kv_soft_evict: true
  kv_evict_threshold: 0.6
  microbatch_cwnd: 1
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
```
That reduced fragmentation and avoided OOMs for a while.

jason: microbatch_cwnd:1 is important here — reduces in-flight KV growth. Also drop max_new_tokens default to 256 for hyperion13b until int4 warmup is stable.

sasha: can we add a quick canary that switches quant profile to int8-fallback on OOM so we can keep traffic while we debug? Something like policy: 
`on_oom: fallback_model_variant: hyperion13b-int8`

mira: good idea. I can push a canary patch. planning steps: disable prefetch -> canary runs -> if stable, enable kv_soft_evict + microbatch tweak -> roll default max_new_tokens -> monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy request received from mira: hyperion13b/canary/soft-evict-2026-03-21 to eng-ml-canary. CI checks passing.

riley: also add a short perf test to measure tail latency: 95/99 pctl with and without soft-evict, because eviction can add latency spikes.

anita: +1 on perf test. Also capture heap map snapshots when fragmentation > 70% so we can run slot-compactor heuristics offline.

mira: will do. I'll update the model defaults PR with the config snippet and a short postmortem if this fixes it.

jason: if OOM persists after soft-evict, we should consider a temporary rollout with `quant_profile: hybrid-int8` for this tenant set until a kernel patch lands.

sasha: tagging @infra to watch GPU memory pressure across the canary fleet.

mira: thanks — I'll post results in this thread after the canary finishes (~30m). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

riley: quick note: add alert rule `hyperion13b_prefetch_oom_rate > 0.5% over 10m` so SRE gets paged before it escalates.

mira: noted, adding alert to PR.

(30m later) mira: canary finished — switching off prefetch + kv_soft_evict + microbatch=1 dropped OOMs to 0 and reduced 99p memory by ~12%. Perf tail latency rose ~6ms at 99p. Proceeding to stage the default max_new_tokens rollback to 256 for the global canary cohort.

anita: awesome. please attach heap snapshots and the perf diff to the PR. We should also file a kernel issue for contiguous slot compaction.

mira: will open ticket and link. Closing loop here. Thanks all. :rocket:
